name: Cruisin' for Love... and murder
source:
Hello, and welcome to the first season of Cruisin' for Love, the reality show where we, and you, sail along the seven seas as our contestants compete for a chance to date our mysterious special guest. However, as romance starts to blossom, will their bonds be strong enough to withstand after our guest reveals their big secret?

Or has this ship already sailed?

[From [url=https://pawggers.itch.io/candm]Itch.io[/url]]
